title: Add five deterministic checks for a decision question
description: Add question_shape, diagram_present, diagram_size, diagram_parses and diagram_labels as deterministic harness checks, each proved both ways, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 5.

acceptanceCriteria.text: question_shape, diagram_present, diagram_size, diagram_parses and diagram_labels each exist in the checks registry
Each of the five is proved both ways: it passes on a conforming reply and fails on a non-conforming one
diagram_size enforces the level node cap and diagram_labels rejects Beginner banned terms in node labels
diagram_parses uses the Mermaid parser and rejects a source it cannot parse
